clues.clue: Freddie Mercury fronted this band, whose six-minute 'Bohemian Rhapsody' careens from ballad to opera to headbanging.
Keith Richards says the fuzzy riff of this band's '(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction' came to him in his sleep.
This 'Stairway to Heaven' band took its name from a joke that the new group would go over like a lead balloon.
Syd Barrett named this 'Dark Side of the Moon' band by combining the first names of two Carolina bluesmen.
Eric Clapton, Jack Bruce, and Ginger Baker formed this short-lived 1960s supergroup behind 'Sunshine of Your Love'.
The only president never elected president or vice president skids into Detroit's galloping pony car of 1964.
The first president to serve two non-consecutive terms tackles the NFL's 'Dawg Pound' franchise on Lake Erie.
The Great Society president merges with the New Jersey pharma giant that made Band-Aids a household name.
Old Hickory, the hero of the Battle of New Orleans, splatters onto the abstract expressionist famed for drip paintings.
The muttonchopped 21st president rallies with the tennis trailblazer who won Wimbledon in 1975.
